<span id="_1-前言"></span>
# 1. Introduction

The event tracking design document is a development\-oriented event tracking requirements manual, the purpose is to let the developer understand what event tracking collection needs to be done under what circumstances, as well as the specific required attribute parameter types and values, to ensure the accuracy and perfection of the collection. In order to achieve the overall indicator system, the landing and use of data products, it is necessary to design the event tracking scheme for development, which is conducive to unified management, modification and maintenance in the future, and ensures that the criteria is unified, traceable and easy to understand.

As an important part of data establishment, event tracking design directly affects the quality of subsequent data applications and data re\-run. We often encounter the following problems in our daily lives:


* As a data product (analyst) who joined a new company, in the face of hundreds of events in the environment, or without any labeled attribute names, he was at a loss and didn't know why, and the documents left by his ex seemed to be missing, and the old employees around him were asked differently. The previous research and development of event tracking also left, so I'll just re\-event tracking...

* As an operator, the event planning is written and the event page is ready. Haha, it's time to show off your skills. I want to analyze the data feedback of different groups of people in detail. All of a sudden, he realized that he didn't have a lot of attribute information. It wasn't enough to subdivide it.

* As a product person, after the new version is launched, I want to analyze the data changes after the new version is launched in detail. Inner os: Fortunately, the demand for event tracking was mentioned before, unlike the above operation, which has no data to check. A few minutes later... Wait, why is this data so different from the back\-end business data...

* As a business person in the company, I heard that the company has a new data product system, but I just learned some basic knowledge of data analytics a while ago, and my heart is: I want to keep improving. Open the system... After a few minutes, the analysis model understands, the meaning of the event understands, and the meaning of the attribute understands, but I don't know the 123,456 values passed here... What do they all mean...


……

From the above scenario, it can be seen that if the underlying construction is not good, it will result in a lot of waste of resources and time costs, as well as a significant reduction in the availability of its own data. Only when event tracking is clearly defined and traceable, business changes can be iterated, and important requirements can be covered, etc., can it avoid later rework, reduce unnecessary time cost waste, improve efficiency, improve data accuracy, and improve data usage.

Event tracking design can be divided into the following three parts:


* Event tracking project planning

* Event tracking design

* Event tracking data promotion application


<span id="_2-埋点项目规划"></span>
# 2. Event tracking project planning

A company not only has BytePlus's growth analysis data products, but also has various data systems such as business databases, machine learning platforms, and bi systems. What kind of needs do growth analysis data products need to undertake, and how to connect various data products is the most important issue to think about at the beginning.

Therefore, initially we can set up:


* Growth analysis data products: mainly undertake the demand for behavioral data and some behavioral\-related business data (such as payment, registration, real\-name authentication, etc.).

* The identification ID of the unique user is established to ensure that the transmission cost of id\-mapping in each data system is not high.

<span id="_2-3-管理小技巧"></span>
## 2.3 Management tips


1. It is recommended to use your R & D request management system for process management. For example, in order to ensure a consistent understanding and traceability of personnel in various departments, strict documentation specifications should be developed, and detailed records should be kept for the date, background description, proponent, review opinion, reviewer, event tracking design plan, event tracking designer, developer, and tester.

2. Clean up regularly. For example, events that have not had data access in the past six months or events that have not been queried in the past six months can be hidden or disabled after service confirmation.

<span id="_3-3-设计自定义埋点方案"></span>
## 3.3 Design a custom event tracking scheme

If you want to analyze the business in depth and form a data\-driven, you need to add more custom code event tracking on the basis of preset events. Custom event tracking offers greater flexibility, autonomy, and applicability. Design event tracking personnel should form event design documents according to the core business requirements and deliver them to the R & D team for data access.

Example of a custom event tracking scheme:


|Serial number |Event name |Event name |Attribute name |Property display name |Attribute type |Property value meaning or example |Event trigger timing |Event tracking |Remarks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|1 |regist_submit |User registration |regist_type |Registration method |string |Mobile phone number/email... |Fired when the registration result is returned |Server level | |
||||is_success |Was it successful? |string |true/false |Fired when the registration result is returned |Server level | |
||||fail_reason |Reason for failure |string |Network reasons/other reasons |Fired when the registration result is returned |Server level | |


<span id="_3-3-1-事件表-自定义埋点设计要素"></span>
### 3.3.1 Transaction table \- custom event tracking design elements


1. **Serial number**

   Each event has a fixed number, which is unique and cannot be modified, making it convenient for document review, backtracking, and management.

2. **Event name**

   Each abstract behavior event, with a Chinese name and an English name, must have a one\-to\-one correspondence between Chinese and English, cannot be repeated, and represents the same meaning. For the naming of events in English, to avoid confusion, it is necessary to adopt a unified specification for naming. Suggested rules are:

   * You can use an underscore \- regist_submit, or a hump name to distinguish registSubmit (joined together by one or more words, the first word starts with a lowercase letter, and the first letter of each word after the second word is uppercase).

   * Use verbs _ nouns or nouns _ verbs to unify.

   * If there are multiple lines of business, you can identify the line of business name before the event, such as a_regist_submit.

   * Case sensitive, if the name is passed, it is not recommended to pass the name.

   * Custom event names must not begin with $.

3. **Event property name**

   Each event attribute, a Chinese name, an English name, must be one\-to\-one correspondence between Chinese and English, representing the same meaning. However, the same attribute can be referenced by multiple events, such as browsing the product details page event and collecting product details event, which can share attributes, product names, product IDs, etc. When the same attribute has similar literal meanings in different events, but the actual meanings are different, reuse is not recommended. It is recommended to distinguish attributes based on their actual meanings. For example, in the event of "animation loading", the property "duration" represents the meaning of "loading time"; in the event of "video playback", the meaning of "duration" represents "playing time". In such cases, it is not recommended to reuse the "duration" field, but to split it into two fields named separately.

   * Attribute naming adopts snake nomenclature, that is, all words are lowercase, and words are divided by "_".

   * Attribute naming usually takes the form of a noun. For example: product_type, product_id, etc.

   * Custom property names must not begin with $.

   * The English and Chinese names of custom properties should be kept strictly one\-to\-one.

   * Case sensitive, if the name is passed, it is not recommended to pass the name.

      **Event & Attribute Restrictions:** 

   * The number of events in a single application should not exceed 1000 (different applications do not affect each other).

   * The recommended number of attributes for a single event is no more than 300, and no more than 500 (different events do not affect each other).

   * The number of custom public attributes for a single application should not exceed 100.

   * The event name and attribute name length are recommended to be within 50 bytes, event attribute names up to 80 bytes, and public attribute names up to 64 bytes.

   * The length of the attribute value is recommended not to exceed 255 bytes, special cases such as url.

   * When the above limit is exceeded, the excess event and attribute data may be automatically discarded by the system.

   * Preset events and properties cannot be modified. In addition, when server level event tracking, preset public properties cannot be automatically collected, and manual transmission is required.

   * Multi\-terminal transmission must unify event and attribute naming to ensure consistent transmission.

4. **Attribute type**

   
   |Attribute value |Meaning |
   |---|---|
   |int |Aggregate operations (e.g. summation, mean) or integer values grouped by intervals are required, typically such as age, purchase quantity, etc. |
   |float |Aggregate operations (e.g., summation, mean) or small values grouped by intervals are required, typically such as price, duration, etc. |
   |string |Text type attribute value type, support include, do not contain, equal and other calculation rules.<br><br>All kinds of IDs, such as item IDs, are recommended to be stored as string types. |
   |list |You need to store multiple values in one field.<br><br>For example, in the "Coupon ID" field when paying for an order, since users can enjoy multiple discounts in one order, the IDs of all coupons need to be stored in a list.<br><br>For example, a product has multiple tags, ['Lunch', 'Discount', 'Christmas'] need to be stored in the form of a list.<br><br>Once the list type is stored, you can query by individual attribute values, such as selecting how many items are labeled with a discount. |
   |datetime |Supports string in datetime format, "2020\-06\-19 17:51:21" |
   

5. **Property value meaning or example**

   This column is intended to clarify the meaning of the attribute field for developers, as well as the description of special cases, so that developers can understand and implement it.

   
   |Attribute type |Example |
   |---|---|
   |Enumerable properties |Gender: male, female |
   |Non\-enumerable properties, can illustrate properties |Product brand: A brand, B brand... |
   

6. **Event triggering timing**

   It is necessary to specify when each event should be triggered. If an event may be triggered at multiple times, it is necessary to sort out all the triggering times. For example, the trigger time of "click to start registration event" should be when you click to register, but registration usually has multiple different entrances. Therefore, business personnel need to clearly enumerate which registration entrances require R & D personnel to perform event tracking. If there is a distinction between attribute values, it should also be marked to avoid omission.

   
   |Event |Attribute |Attribute value |Trigger timing |
   |---|---|---|---|
   |Click to start registration |Registration |Home page top right<br><br>Login page to register<br><br>Below the home page |* Triggered when clicking Register in the upper right corner of the homepage, and the property value of the registration entrance is transmitted [Top right of the homepage]<br><br>* Triggered when the login page clicks to register, and the registration entrance attribute value is passed [login page to register]<br><br>* It is triggered when you click to take a look at the bottom of the homepage, and the registration entrance attribute value is transmitted [below the homepage]. |
   

7. **Event tracking form**

   The event tracking form supports both front\-end and back\-end. Triggered at different times, the data results are inconsistent. For example, the registration event is triggered when the front\-end submits the registration, and it is impossible to determine whether the registration succeeds or fails. Triggered after the back\-end registration returns the result, which can not only clarify the registration result, but also avoid the loss of front\-end data. In general, core business process events recommend backend event tracking to ensure data accuracy, such as product purchase, successful registration, etc. In special cases, you can also use the front\-end and back\-end collaboration for event tracking. After the collected data is passed to the other end, the data receiving end triggers the event tracking.

   
   |Event tracking form |Explain |
   |---|---|
   |Front end (client side) |Interactive, click, browse front\-end collection. |
   |Backend (server level) |Core business such as payment, registration, etc., backend is recommended. |
   

8. **Remarks**

   It can be prioritized and noted for other special circumstances.


<span id="_3-3-2-用户表设计要素"></span>
### 3.3.2 User Table Design Elements


1. **User attributes**

   User attributes need to be attributes that describe the user's longer\-term state, such as demographic info, account information, and so on.

2. **Changed user attributes**

   First, user attributes can be updated, such as VIP level, last payment time, and so on. It should be noted that, for example, the user's VIP level, the user attribute only records the current latest status, for example, the VIP level can be changed from level 1 to level 2, or from level 4 to non\-VIP, and the user attribute only records the latest status of the user's current VIP level. If you want to obtain the VIP level requirements of the user when operating in the historical state, you also need to increase the VIP level of the event attribute, which can be selected according to specific needs. If there is any ambiguity, please consult the relevant service support personnel.


<span id="_3-3-3-公共属性"></span>
### 3.3.3 Public attributes

Common attributes are attributes that are common to all events, such as the platform where the event occurs, the business module to which the event belongs, and so on. Public attributes can be ignored when there is no such business requirement.

<span id="_3-3-4-整体的设计思路"></span>
### 3.3.4 Overall design idea

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />


1. **Establish observation metrics**

   According to the index system established in the early stage, sort them out one by one.

2. **Abstract process behavior**

   Behavioral events that abstract metrics, such as want to observe payment conversion rates? The definition of clear payment conversion rate is the application launch \- enter the product list page \- browse the product details page \- submit the order \- pay success conversion rate, and abstract each action as an event.

3. **Supplementary event properties**

   To observe the payment conversion rate, business needs are far from enough. It is also necessary to observe the conversion rate of different commodity prices, the conversion rate of different stores, and the conversion rate of different commodity classifications. Therefore, it is necessary to add event attributes to events that can record these relevant information to facilitate later dimensional splitting. As shown in the figure, browsing the product details page can add product\-related properties.

4. **Design Event Elements**

   The event triggering form, English name, event tracking terminal, property value type, and property value examples are completed.

5. **Supplementary user attributes**

   If you want to see the difference in user conversion rates by gender and registration month, you need to add user attributes.


<span id="_3-4-确认是否需要导入后台业务数据库、标签等数据"></span>
## 3.4 Confirm whether it is necessary to import background business database, labels and other data

In more business scenarios, there are many more complex data, such as bank loan business database, the risk control level calculated for each user can be imported as user attributes.

For example, retail transactions in the offline, the occurrence of behavior is not online, or online education, the customer's offline phone re\-engagement recall, can not be used as online behavior data collection, this data stored in the business database, can also do events and attributes abstract, with the business database import method, and determine the import cycle frequency (by day, by week, etc.), regularly import.

<span id="_3-5-确认可行性和排期"></span>
## 3.5 Confirmation of feasibility and schedule

Designers should confirm the feasibility and cost of event and attribute collection one by one with R & D, and make trade\-offs for requirements that are expensive to implement and need to be less important, and formulate a schedule for the overall event tracking priority.

<span id="_4-常见问题"></span>
# 4. Frequently Asked Questions


1. **Are similar scenes merged into one event or divided into different events?** 

   
   |Event design |Scene example |Explain |Event Design Example |
   |---|---|---|---|
   |Designed for the same event |For example, button clicks in similar scenarios can be merged, without having to click one event at a time, they need to be merged into one event. |For global events, we recommend that they be designed as the same event, with specific actions differentiated by specific property values, rather than one event per operation. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ef6690062b4a47608db1f0615ba41ab4~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
   |Designed for the same event |For example, clicking on the banner and clicking on the popular activity bit are all recommended bits on the homepage, which can be distinguished by adding attributes. |The required attributes of each event are not much different, and the analysis scenarios are usually analyzed as a whole. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/a105f16e9cb1416abde80d5b48d77b3d~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
   |Designed for different events |For example, a content platform has videos and articles. Due to the large differences in the recorded attributes of videos and articles, the browsing content details should be divided into browsing video details and browsing article details |The required attributes of each event vary widely, and the analysis scenarios are mostly analyzed separately. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/35dfa429cc5e488c86658b0a71d9fd37~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
   |Designed for different events |For example, collecting goods and browsing product details, although there is little difference in attributes, the collection and browsing business are not closely related, and are usually analyzed separately. |The required attributes of each event are not much different, but usually the analysis scenario is single, and the business meaning is quite different. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/11a253f920174755942ae1ad7f69c797~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
   

2. **Design for multi\-identity users**

   In online education users, there are multiple user identities, such as teachers, students, parents, etc. It is necessary to distinguish user attributes and set the attributes of users with different identities differently.

3. **Active and passive event handling**

   In online behavior, many event tracking events that need to be recorded are not actively triggered by the user, but are passively triggered, such as platform review, issuing coupons, being followed by others, etc. Therefore, there is no active event in this scenario, and the active trigger behavior is not the user. The user is the recipient of the behavior and is passively affected. However, in the analysis of requirements such as audit pass rate, need to submit the audit \- the subject ID of the audit is one person, at this time, the subject of the passive event will affect the analysis results , specific processing methods, see official documents [Passive and Relational Events](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Passive_and_Relational_Events).

4. **Handling of exposure events**

   Like other events, only the triggering timing of the exposure event needs to be paid attention to. For example, the triggering timing of a platform content exposure event is:

   1. The entire content is exposed, and the feed stream is still for more than 2s.

   2. Limit a single content request to only one exposure (e.g. swipe the screen up and down, as long as a new request does not refresh, it counts as one exposure).

      The above are just examples, and the specific rules can be flexibly changed according to demand and the implementation cost of R & D. In addition, it should be noted that the amount of exposure triggering events is huge, general analysis of CTR, or when there are recommended algorithm demands for data, exposure events are required, and other scenarios should be carefully tracked according to demand.

5. **Virtual event**

   Virtual events are the merging and splitting of meta events and are a special feature. Therefore, in the event tracking design, if the virtual event can be satisfied, there is no need to add new event tracking.

   
   |Event type |Example |Diagram |
   |---|---|---|
   |Merge event |For example, the interactive behavior of social platforms includes: likes, comments, likes, sending private messages and many other behaviors. At this time, the demand wants to analyze the number of users who interact on the same day and deduplicate. Events can be merged. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/090549627c204ccf83db19b4752b5bda~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
   |Split event |For example, during the 618 e\-commerce event, frequently check the number of products added to the shopping cart with 200 minus 20 labels. If you don't want repetitive configuration metrics, you can set virtual events. |without |
